notes: NASDUCK-SERF SERF comagnetometer with 3He (neutron-sensitive) and 39K (proton-sensitive). Paper reports BOTH ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) 95% C.L. limits over mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. I extracted the neutron bound per hint. The proton bound (gaPP, ~5e-6 to few e-3 GeV^-1) is the paper's key novelty (first reliable terrestrial proton bound). Numerical values come from reading Fig. 2 (mean/red-band curves); exact per-mass tabulation is in external repo github.com/ItayBM/NASDUCKSERF (not in paper text), so data points are approximate. Couplings are quoted in GeV^-1, not dimensionless g_an — downstream conversion needed. Coupling-type ambiguity (neutron vs proton) lowers confidence.
